races.paceDynamic: Theflyingking, Astelia, Certamen, Hathaways Cottage and Cinnabar Moth will ensure a relentless gallop from the flag in this 23-runner maiden. The pace will be strong throughout with multiple front-runners committed to making it a test of stamina over the 2m1½f trip. With five confirmed pace-setters and a large field creating traffic problems, this race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce late runs and avoid the early scramble.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heroes Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the pace-setters go too fast early and fade in the straight
scenarios.body: The strong early gallop will set up perfectly for closers like Small Fry and Loyal Touch who can pick off tired leaders. Traffic won't be an issue for patient riders who time their runs perfectly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Wins
scenarios.trigger: If one prominent runner finds the perfect stalking position behind the pace
scenarios.body: Ehteyat or Angelo Dundee can track the early leaders without getting involved in the speed battle, then strike when the front-runners weaken. Their class will tell in a competitive finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Theflyingking or Astelia can dictate terms and see off rivals
scenarios.body: One pace-setter will get first run on their rivals and prove too strong for the closers who leave it too late. The winner will need stamina reserves to resist late challenges.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Shock Outsider Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the favourite types underperform and an unconsidered runner strikes
scenarios.body: Traffic problems and a messy pace could see an unfancied runner like Clone Cross or Victoria Kesia sneak through when others are stopping. Chaos in a big field creates opportunities.

Traffic problems in a 23-runner field could trap hold-up horses at crucial moments
Small Fry's 514-day layoff is a concern despite his excellent form when last seen

First-time headgear on Loyal Touch and Persian Bliss could spark improved efforts

races.paceDynamic: Stay In The Game represents the lone confirmed front runner, with Portetta, Truckers Cruising, Harley Street and Grey Gardens likely to sit prominent. With only one natural leader in a 23-runner field, Stay In The Game can dictate terms and establish a manageable gallop without early pressure. The lack of pace pressure early should create a tactical affair that builds steadily, with the large field compacting as they approach the final half-mile. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can track the pace and have tactical speed, as they can position close enough to strike but avoid the late traffic that will engulf hold-up horses in such a large field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Stay In The Game gets an easy lead and maintains stamina reserves
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows him to control sectionals perfectly, while the big field creates a wall of traffic behind that prevents late challengers from getting clear runs. Prominent trackers get the clearest passage but can't reel in the stamina-conserving leader.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace builds steadily and prominent runners get clear runs
scenarios.body: The measured gallop suits horses with tactical speed who can position handily, allowing them to quicken when it matters while avoiding the inevitable traffic problems further back. Hold-up horses struggle to weave through the large field.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Threading
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and gaps appear late
scenarios.body: A crawling gallop stretches the field and creates space for patient hold-up horses to find racing room, but they need significant luck with gaps in such a big field. The tactical nature still favours those closer to the pace.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Stay In The Game fades and multiple horses challenge simultaneously
scenarios.body: The leader's stamina gives out from controlling the race alone, creating a messy finish where any horse with a clear passage can capitalise. Speed rather than stamina becomes the decisive factor.

watchPoints.text: Stay In The Game could get an uncontested lead and prove very difficult to peg back with his tactical advantage

Several prominent runners including Harley Street and Grey Gardens have fade-in-finish warnings that could derail their chances
Portetta and Truckers Cruising are best positioned to track the leader and have the clearest runs when it matters
The amateur rider on Stay In The Game may not maximise the horse's tactical advantage despite controlling the pace

races.paceDynamic: He Can't Dance will dictate terms from the front with no obvious pressure, having led successfully last time at this course. Timeless Treaty and Kevin's Pride are likely to track him prominently, but neither looks keen to take him on early in a small field. The lack of genuine pace pressure means He Can't Dance can control splits and kick when ready, while the hold-up horses Herja, Huntsgrove and Love Like This face the classic problem of relying on others to set it up. This race shape strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can position close to the pace without having to make ground late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If He Can't Dance gets an easy lead and is allowed to dictate fractions
scenarios.body: He sets sustainable splits and has plenty left for the finish, while the hold-up horses find themselves with too much to do from the back. The prominent horses get closest but lack the tactical advantage of controlling the race.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressure Pays
scenarios.trigger: If Timeless Treaty or Kevin's Pride apply early pressure to He Can't Dance
scenarios.body: The pace becomes genuine enough to set it up for a strong closer, with the early leaders softening each other up. Herja's class and hold-up style becomes an asset rather than a hindrance.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Messy Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the pace goes to sleep completely with no one willing to go forward
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the final flight where class and finishing speed matter most. Timeless Treaty's superior rating and recent form give him the edge in a rough finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Long Shot Special
scenarios.trigger: If the class horses underperform or make jumping errors at crucial stages
scenarios.body: The race opens up for a horse who gets an ideal trip and jumps fluently throughout. Lark Walk's unknown quantity status or Kevin's Pride's consistency could pay dividends.

watchPoints.text: He Can't Dance jumping early obstacles - any mistake could hand initiative to prominent racers and change entire race dynamic
Timeless Treaty's fitness after 28-day break - Elliott runner could be short of peak condition despite strong recent form
Lark Walk's early positioning - unknown style profile could disrupt expected pace scenario if goes forward unexpectedly
Kevin's Pride's stamina at 3m trip - previous wins came over shorter distances and step up in trip is unproven
Weather conditions pre-race - any ground changes could particularly impact the hold-up horses' already slim chances

races.paceDynamic: Scalpnagoon is the sole identified front-runner and will dictate proceedings from the start, likely setting a manageable tempo without pressure given the field composition. The majority of runners (Staffordshire Knot, Court Canyon, Impero, Cinammon Roll, Sampoet) are prominent racers who will track behind in a compact group, while only Takenasred and Astley are designated hold-up horses. With no genuine pace pressure on Scalpnagoon and most runners happy to sit handy, this sets up a tactical affair that will likely develop into a sprint from the last fence. This race shape clearly favours the prominent racers who can position themselves perfectly behind the leader and have first run on the hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Racers Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Scalpnagoon sets steady fractions and the prominent pack stay within striking distance
scenarios.body: The handy horses get first run from the last and the hold-up pair struggle to make up ground in time. Court Canyon and Impero look best placed to capitalise from their tracking positions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Scalpnagoon Wires Field
scenarios.trigger: If the front-runner jumps fluently and maintains his galloping rhythm throughout
scenarios.body: His 122 hurdles rating suggests he has the class to make all if allowed an easy lead. The prominent horses may leave their challenges too late against a horse who stays strongly.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Late Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes stronger than expected and the prominent runners compromise each other
scenarios.body: Takenasred or Astley could benefit from a truly-run race where the handy horses tie up. The race would need genuine pace pressure to set this up properly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Scalpnagoon goes very slowly and creates a messy tactical battle
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from three out where any horse can win regardless of style. This would create the most open finish but seems unlikely given the field makeup.

watchPoints.text: Impero's 321-day absence could leave him badly ring-rusty despite his obvious class advantage over this field
Scalpnagoon's jumping accuracy will determine if he can make his front-running tactics pay or become vulnerable late
Elliott's three runners (Staffordshire Knot, Cinammon Roll, Scalpnagoon) suggest the stable expects one to be competitive
The lack of genuine pace horses behind Scalpnagoon could create a stop-start rhythm that suits nobody
Court Canyon's trainer Donoghue has a 17% strike rate recently and this horse fits his typical profile of improver

races.paceDynamic: Secrecies Of Stone stands alone as the only prominent runner in a field of eight hold-up horses, guaranteeing an uncontested lead and sustainable fractions. With no early pace pressure, Secrecies Of Stone can dictate terms entirely, setting steady splits that could blunt the finishing kicks of the back markers. The lack of pace competition means the winner will likely come from those able to track the leader closely or those with exceptional finishing speed. This race shape heavily favours horses that can race handily behind the leader rather than those relying purely on late surges from the rear.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Triumph
scenarios.trigger: If Secrecies Of Stone maintains steady fractions without pressure and stays on strongly.
scenarios.body: The soft pace allows Secrecies Of Stone to conserve energy early and resist late challenges, while the hold-up horses struggle to make up ground from too far back. Those tracking closest have the best chance if the leader falters.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Class Hold-Up Victory
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too slow and favours horses with superior ratings and finishing kicks.
scenarios.body: Hardy Diamond or Tullyveery Lad use their class advantage to overcome the tactical deficit, with their superior RPR figures telling in the closing stages. The Elliott-trained Hardy Diamond particularly benefits from tracking duties.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Fresh Finisher Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If returning horses show significant improvement after breaks and benefit from the slow pace.
scenarios.body: Secrecies Of Stone (62 days off) or Digby (24 days off) produce career-best efforts when the race sets up perfectly for their styles. The extended breaks prove beneficial rather than detrimental.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Surprise Package
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and a lightly-weighted runner produces an unexpected surge.
scenarios.body: Barrow Ranger or Attaboyarchie benefit from their low weights (142lbs and 149lbs respectively) when the race becomes a sprint finish. The significant weight concessions prove decisive in a slowly-run affair.

watchPoints.text: Secrecies Of Stone could steal this race if allowed completely uncontested fractions with no early pace pressure

Tullyveery Lad has winning form and excellent going record but must overcome poor tactical position from rear
Weight concessions to Barrow Ranger (142lbs) and Attaboyarchie (149lbs) become crucial in slowly-run finish
Several runners including Digby and Bodhisattva return from breaks with form concerns that need monitoring

races.paceDynamic: Colvin will be the primary pace-setter with his prominent style, likely joined by Focus Point and potentially Chateau Elan in the early stages. With only one confirmed front runner and several hold-up horses, the pace should be sustainable rather than frantic. The two hold-up runners Catalani and Yewtree Hill will track the field before making late moves. This setup creates a tactical race where prominent runners who can stay close to the pace will have the advantage over pure hold-up horses who may find insufficient early speed to close into.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Colvin Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Colvin gets an uncontested lead and maintains a steady gallop
scenarios.body: The front runner dictates terms and has enough left to resist challenges, while prominent runners Focus Point and Chateau Elan benefit from the honest pace. Hold-up horses struggle to make up ground on the good going.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle Develops
scenarios.trigger: If Focus Point and Chateau Elan press Colvin early creating stronger pace
scenarios.body: The increased tempo suits the hold-up runners who get more pace to aim at in the closing stages. Catalani and Yewtree Hill can time their challenges better with more to close into.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too slow and bunches the field for a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get their ideal scenario with a soft pace followed by a cavalry charge. Catalani's better recent form and Yewtree Hill's versatility become crucial factors.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Winner Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the likely pace-setters falter or make jumping errors
scenarios.body: The lightly raced Fortune Lad or That's It Paddy capitalize on a more open race where experience and class tell less. Fresh legs and unknown improvement could trump proven form.
